purpose: Engineering and development comparison only. No independent confirmation, no clinical claim.
source: Read only the completed 20261116 pilot. Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SAM and original evaluator frozen.
roles: First 4 original training trajectories per task for proposals; 5th training image for direct executor preflight. First 4 original validation groups in fixed manifest order for development gates, both tasks. Never open original test or confirmation.
initial_state: Empty committed library. One model-generated shared draft per task. A draft is an editing starting point only, never deployed or selected on the gate.
comparison: Same task-local shared draft, training evidence and prompt schema, one candidate per arm with one format repair, same 2048 output token cap. Full rewrites one full skill; edit applies up to two localized edits, or one create if the shared draft failed. Raw context omitted in both arms to isolate skill behavior. Prior-task skills are preserved; they can still be selected by the unmodified graph controller.
selection: Require direct execution and scorable output on the training probe first, then actual use of the new skill by GraphAgent on development data plus unchanged original HCL quality/efficiency and old-task gates. Record failed candidates. Historical reference is the end-of-T1 incumbent for each arm. No candidate after observing per-case validation feedback.
stop: One attempt with shared deadline including any retries. No more candidates after development evaluation, no replacement of cases, no reuse of 8 old confirmation groups.
